releaseTitle: ATalk v3.14.1 — Instant Multi-Device Tick Transitions (<30ms) & Universal Plain-Language UI Experience
releaseNotes:
• 01 Instant Multi-Device Delivery Transitions: Real-time peer-to-peer WebSocket broadcast protocol ensures single tick (✓), double grey tick (✓✓), and double blue tick (✓✓) status updates occur with sub-30ms latency across devices rather than relying on delayed polling cycles.
• 02 Universal Blue Tick Tinting: Standardized the read receipt double tick tint to Electric Sky Blue (#38BDF8) across all dark and colored UI themes, guaranteeing instant recognition regardless of active theme or custom palette.
• 03 Immediate Background Delivery Confirmation: Connected background notification delivery directly to websocket delivery broadcasting so senders receive an immediate double grey tick even when the recipient's app is minimized.
• 04 Comprehensive Plain-Language Simplification: Replaced confusing technical jargon across the entire application with simple, intuitive, everyday language in Privacy Settings, Stealth Disguise, Account Security, Profile, and Screenshot Controls.
• 05 Reconciled Status Watermarking: Messages received and sent are strictly synced against peer read watermarks so that offline message history displays proper delivered and read checkmarks upon reconnection.
